name: Advance one real turn and read actual Government Plaza building and spy capacity

condition.code: local p=Players[Game.GetLocalPlayer()]; return p and p:IsTurnActive() and type(ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary)=='table'

steps.code: assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_BOUNDARY_CAPACITY_PROGRESS'),'official capacity building progress receipt missing'); local p=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.CaptiveCapacityPlan(); assert(p.occupied==1 and p.capacity==1,'native captive capacity already changed'); return p.stage

condition.code: local p=Players[Game.GetLocalPlayer()]; return p and p:IsTurnActive() and type(ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary)=='table'

steps.code: local b=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary; local p=b.CaptiveCapacityPlan(); assert(p.occupied==1 and (p.stage=='BUILD_SPIES' or p.stage=='CAPACITY_READY' or p.stage=='EFFECT_PENDING' or p.stage=='PROGRESS_PENDING'),'native capacity route changed unexpectedly: '..p.stage); return p.stage..' capacity='..p.capacity..' occupied='..p.occupied
